name: UninstallPKG
product: UninstallPKG by CoreCode

evidence.says: CoreCode offers UninstallPKG as a standalone utility for removing installed macOS packages.
CoreCode states that UninstallPKG 1.2.0 introduced native M1 support and lists 1.2.2 as the latest release.
CoreCode announced UninstallPKG 1.2.2 on November 5, 2024.
The official ZIP contains UninstallPKG 1.2.2 with the matching bundle ID and its main UninstallPKG executable is a universal arm64 and x86_64 Mach-O.

notes: This is a standalone utility for removing arbitrary macOS packages.

name: CAD Assistant
product: CAD Assistant by Open Cascade

evidence.says: Open Cascade lists CAD Assistant 1.6.0 as the latest release and offers separate ARM64 and Intel x86_64 macOS disk images.

name: Alpha Centauri
product: Wineskin wrapper for GOG’s edition of Sid Meier’s Alpha Centauri Planetary Pack (Firaxis Games)

evidence.says: The original scan’s plist identifies WineskinLauncher as the executable and a Windows .exe as its target.
GOG lists the separately identified Sid Meier’s Alpha Centauri Planetary Pack game.

limitation: The version and architecture of the current GOG Mac package were not verified.
notes: The scanned bundle is a Wine wrapper around the Windows game, with a placeholder version.

name: The Dame Was Loaded
product: GOG DOSBox launcher for The Dame Was Loaded (Beam Software)

evidence.says: GOG identifies the game as DOSBox-powered and documents the switch to DOSBox Staging in its 1.0 GOG v2 changelog.

limitation: The architecture of GOG’s current macOS launcher was not verified.
notes: The scan labels the executable Launcher and carries a The Dame Was Loaded bundle ID inside an archive named Eye of the Beholder III.

name: SecondLife
product: Second Life Viewer by Linden Lab

evidence.says: Linden Lab dates the default 26.5.0.42122621216 viewer build November 14, 2026 and links its macOS build with a _universal.dmg filename.
Linden Lab offers 26.5.0.42122621216 as the default Mac viewer download.

name: eParaksts-Safari
product: eParaksts Token Signing Safari extension host by LVRTC

evidence.says: The original scan’s plist identifies the exact eParaksts-Safari host bundle and marks it as a background UI element.
LVRTC describes the Safari component as a browser extension for smart-card signing and authentication.

limitation: The current Safari extension host version and architecture were not verified.
notes: The eParakstītājs 3.0 desktop signing application is a separate listing.

name: LogitechGamingInstaller
product: Logitech Gaming Software installer by Logitech

evidence.says: The original scan’s plist identifies LogitechGamingInstaller as both the bundle executable and bundle name.
Logitech lists the historical versions of its separate Gaming Software product for Mac.

limitation: The installed software’s architecture is outside the scanned installer bundle.
notes: The submitted bundle is the installer rather than the installed peripheral configuration app.

name: LaCie Desktop Manager
product: LaCie Desktop Manager by LaCie (Seagate)

evidence.says: Seagate includes LaCie Desktop Manager in its end-of-service-life software list.
Seagate lists Desktop Manager 3.2.0, says it was not updated for Big Sur, and names Mojave as the last supported macOS version.

limitation: The final executable architecture and release date were not independently verified.
notes: The scan used the launcher's bundle ID for the discontinued Desktop Manager package.

name: LaCie Toolkit Installer
product: LaCie Toolkit Installer by LaCie (Seagate)

evidence.says: Seagate directs Mac users to launch LaCie Toolkit Installer from LaCieToolkit.zip specifically to install the Toolkit application.

name: Install League of Legends eune
product: League of Legends EU Nordic and East Mac installer by Riot Games

evidence.says: Riot's EU Nordic and East download page offers the Mac installer for League of Legends.
Riot documents the installed League of Legends app and the Riot Client as separately identifiable components on Mac.

notes: The scanned item is the regional installer, which shares the Riot Client identifier.

name: Synthesia
product: Synthesia piano practice app by Synthesia LLC

evidence.says: The official download for macOS is Synthesia 10.9.
Synthesia dates 10.9 to December 21, 2022 and records the introduction of Apple Silicon support for macOS in 10.8.
Inspection of the official disk image found both x86_64 and arm64 in Synthesia.app/Contents/MacOS/Synthesia, with bundle ID com.synthesiallc.synthesia and version 10.9.5893 in Info.plist.

name: Better
product: Better Blocker for Safari by Small Technology Foundation (formerly Ind.ie)

evidence.says: The developer describes Better Blocker as a completed 2016–2021 project for Safari on iPhone, iPad and Mac.
The publisher records co-creator Laura Kalbag's farewell announcement for Better Blocker.

limitation: The final Mac build and its architecture could not be verified.

name: Frogger TT
product: Frogger in Toy Town retail demo by Konami and Q-Games

evidence.says: Konami identifies the public product as Frogger in Toy Town for Apple Arcade and says service ended in April 2024.
The publisher identifies the original public Mac distribution as the Apple Arcade edition.

limitation: The retail demo’s final binary architecture was not established.
notes: The scanned bundle ID ends in .retaildemo, identifying a store display build distinct from the public Apple Arcade game.

name: FusionAccess
product: Huawei FusionAccess desktop virtualization client by Huawei

evidence.says: Huawei describes FusionAccess as part of its FusionCloud virtual desktop system.
Huawei Cloud offers macOS downloads under the Workspace product name.

limitation: The current Mac client version and architecture for com.huawei.fusionaccess could not be established.
notes: Huawei Cloud also offers a Workspace client. Its documentation does not connect that download to the scanned FusionAccess bundle ID.

name: Aria2GUI
product: Aria2GUI for macOS by Nick Yang

evidence.says: The archived maintainer releases page lists Aria2GUI 1.4.1 as the latest release and says the repository was made read-only on November 19, 2019.
Homebrew's historical cask identifies the bundle as com.Aria2GUI, pins version 1.4.1, and records the reason for disabling it as discontinued.

limitation: The last release's binary architecture and exact publication date were not verified.
notes: The command-line aria2 project and separately maintained frontends have their own releases.

name: Twine
product: Twine desktop interactive fiction editor by Chris Klimas and the Twine contributors

evidence.says: The Twine maintainers publish the 2.12.1 desktop release.
The release metadata lists Twine-2.12.1-macOS.dmg as an official asset and timestamps publication on October 7, 2026 UTC.
The configuration at the 2.12.1 release tag specifies a universal macOS DMG with the same filename as the published asset.

notes: The current packaging configuration uses org.twinery.twine, while the old scan has Electron's com.electron.twine identifier.

name: Bible Study
product: Olive Tree Bible Study for Mac by Olive Tree Bible Software

evidence.says: Olive Tree directs Mac users to the Mac App Store for its Bible Study application.
Apple lists the exact Mac bundle com.olivetree.BibleReaderMac at version 8.1.5, released October 26, 2026.

limitation: Neither Olive Tree nor Apple identifies the architecture of 8.1.5, and the store binary was not inspected.

name: Pulse
product: Pulse Downloader by Pulse Audio

evidence.says: Pulse provides distinct Apple Silicon and Intel Mac downloads for its sample-library and plug-in manager.
The vendor’s current Apple Silicon download resolves to the versioned 40.4.30 arm64 DMG and responds with HTTP 200.

limitation: The DMG has an October 7, 2026 server modification date, but a release date was not separately confirmed.
notes: The name-matched Homebrew cask is for Egoist’s unrelated Pulse app.

name: ILGExam360
product: ILG Exam360 by ILG Technologies

evidence.says: ILG publishes macOS requirements and provides the actual exam application through a user account.
The New Jersey Board of Bar Examiners confirms its Mac users get the ILG Exam360 download from their applicant account.

limitation: The vendor’s generic processor requirements do not establish whether the account-gated Mac build is Intel-only or native, and the current version was not verified.

name: eparakstitajs3
product: eParakstītājs 3.0 by Latvijas Valsts radio un televīzijas centrs (LVRTC)

evidence.says: LVRTC announced availability of version 1.11.0 on October 15, 2026 and lists added macOS ARM support.
The official download page labels its version 1.11.0 aarch64 package as Mac ARM.
The versioned official macOS aarch64 package linked by the vendor is available.

notes: The desktop signing app is separate from the Safari browser component.

name: RipIt
product: RipIt DVD ripper by The Little App Factory

evidence.says: The architecture inventory for the exact RipIt bundle reports Intel builds and says the publisher stopped maintaining it after 1.6.9.
The release listing shows 1.6.9 last updated June 13, 2016 and includes firsthand reports that the vendor’s distribution site shut down.
The original scan of version 1.6.9 records x86 architecture for the exact bundle.

limitation: No official retirement announcement was available, and operation on current Apple Silicon macOS was not tested.
notes: The final located release was Intel-only.

name: AJA eMini-Setup
product: AJA eMini-Setup by AJA Video Systems

evidence.says: AJA lists eMini-Setup 2.4.5 for macOS with a July 16, 2026 release date.

Inspection of AJA_eMini-Setup-2.4.5.7.dmg inside the official ZIP found x86_64 and arm64 in AJA eMini-Setup.app/Contents/MacOS/eminisetup, with bundle ID com.aja.eMiniSetup and version 2.4.5.7 in Info.plist.

notes: AJA markets this build as version 2.4.5.

name: AJA RovoControl
product: AJA RovoControl for RovoCam by AJA Video Systems

evidence.says: AJA lists RovoControl 3.0.1 as the latest Mac release, dated January 10, 2020, and names macOS Catalina support.

Inspection of AJARovoControl_3_0_1.dmg inside the official ZIP found only x86_64 in AJA RovoControl.app/Contents/MacOS/ajarovocontrol, with bundle ID com.aja.rovocontrol and version 3.0.1 in Info.plist.

limitation: Rosetta 2 operation has not been verified.

name: Crossy Castle
product: Crossy Road Castle retail demo by Hipster Whale

evidence.says: Hipster Whale names Crossy Road Castle and its public Apple Arcade release.
Apple distributes the public Crossy Road Castle game for Mac through Apple Arcade under Hipster Whale's name.
Apple identifies the public Mac game as com.hipsterwhale.crossycastle.macos.

limitation: The architecture of the retail demo was not established.
notes: The scanned bundle ID ends in .retaildemo, identifying a store display build distinct from the Apple Arcade release.

name: UpNote
product: UpNote for macOS by UpNote Company Limited

evidence.says: Apple lists version 9.22.9, released October 26, 2026, for com.getupnote.desktop.
The live macOS binary-analysis record identifies UpNote 9.22.9 as universal and reports both arm64 and x86_64.
Desktop Insights documents that it downloads and analyzes shipped application binaries.

limitation: The architecture was verified from published binary analysis without independently inspecting the App Store package.

name: BatchOutput PPT
product: BatchOutput PPT by Zevrix Solutions

evidence.says: Zevrix explicitly lists native Apple Silicon and Intel support for BatchOutput PPT 3 in the BatchOutput Office version 3 upgrade.
The vendor labels its current PowerPoint release BatchOutput PPT 3.0 and lists the 2.x series under legacy versions.
The live distribution record dates the version 3.0 update September 29, 2026.

limitation: The version date is reported by MacUpdate.

name: SMARTReporter-DEMO
product: SMARTReporter by CoreCode, originally scanned as the demo edition

evidence.says: The original demo bundle declares the SMARTReporter 3 appcast used by the current free build.
The demo bundle’s official update feed offers SMARTReporter 3.2.0 build 2576, dated January 4, 2022.
CoreCode states that SMARTReporter 3.2.0 added native Apple Silicon support.
The official download was inspected and SMARTReporter Free.app/Contents/MacOS/SMARTReporter Free is a universal arm64 and x86_64 Mach-O in version 3.2.0 build 2576.

notes: CoreCode made SMARTReporter free at 3.2, and the update offered by the trial’s feed uses bundle ID com.corecode.SMARTReporter.

name: WeatherBug
product: WeatherBug for Mac by Earth Networks, later sold to xAd (GroundTruth)

evidence.says: Apple's lookup for the historical Mac App Store product returns zero results.
WeatherBug's current supported-platform list covers mobile apps and desktop browsers and omits a standalone Mac app.
Earth Networks confirms it developed the WeatherBug desktop and mobile apps and sold the brand to xAd in late 2016.
The historical Mac listing dates version 1.0.2 to February 21, 2017 and lists Intel 64-bit architecture.

limitation: The final known Mac build is reported as Intel 64-bit. Its binary and Rosetta behavior were not independently tested.
notes: The current mobile WeatherBug app uses a separate App Store record.

name: Only Friends
product: Only Friends, an unidentified ToDesktop-packaged Mac app

evidence.says: The historical scan identifies a ToDesktop bundle for Only Friends 1.11.0 and declares the developer-tools category.
ToDesktop documents how its generated app identifiers map to direct download links, and the historical identifier no longer resolves there.

limitation: The original website, publisher, current distribution, and architecture could not be established.
notes: Category follows the historical bundle's LSApplicationCategoryType declaration.

name: Ultimate Guitar - Chords & Tabs
product: Ultimate Guitar: Chords & Tabs for Mac (Mac Catalyst) by Ultimate Guitar USA

evidence.says: Apple's lookup returns no result for the exact Mac Catalyst bundle identifier.
Apple's current Ultimate Guitar record identifies the mobile app as com.ultimateguitar.tabs100.
The current App Store product page does not list macOS in its compatibility details.

limitation: The current distribution, version, and architecture of the standalone Mac Catalyst bundle could not be verified.
notes: Apple's active iOS listing has a different bundle ID.

name: QREncoder
product: QREncoder for Mac by Peter Nikolow (Mobilio Development)

evidence.says: The developer lists 1.5 as the latest update for the free Mac app and links to Apple App Store item 452695239 as its download.
Apple's US Mac App Store lookup returns zero results for the developer's item ID.

limitation: The final binary architecture and release date of version 1.5 were not verified.
notes: The developer's App Store link returns 404, and Apple's US, UK, Japan and Bulgaria storefront lookups returned no matching Mac software.

name: Roon
product: Roon Desktop by Roon Labs

evidence.says: Roon Labs identifies the current production desktop hotfix as 2.75.1 build 1727, released November 24, 2026.
Roon Labs says its Roon 2.0 transition introduced native Apple Silicon support on macOS without Rosetta.
Roon's current macOS setup guide covers the Mac desktop app and documents native Apple Silicon operation.

notes: The claim covers the Roon desktop app.

name: AJA Mini-Config
product: AJA Mini-Config by AJA Video Systems

evidence.says: AJA lists Mini-Config 2.27.1 as the macOS download, released April 7, 2026.
AJA's manual says Mini-Config supports both Intel and Apple Silicon Macs, without specifying how the app runs on Apple Silicon.

limitation: The release executable's architecture and any reliance on Rosetta were not established.
notes: The official archive exceeds the 150 MB binary inspection limit.

name: PhotoJob 2-Demo
product: PhotoJob 2 trial build by RootRise Technologies

evidence.says: RootRise now offers the Mac product through the Mac App Store.
The Mac App Store release history shows PhotoJob 2 continuing into PhotoJob 3, which replaced the old trial distribution with an in-app free tier and optional premium trial.
Apple identifies the current PhotoJob 3 Mac app as com.RootRiseTechnologies.PhotoJob-2.

limitation: No final version or architecture was verified for the separate com.RootRiseTechnologies.PhotoJob-2-Demo build.
notes: The same product continues as PhotoJob 3, and the Mac App Store release notes identify 2.5.1 of that distribution as universal.

name: Perfect Privacy VPN
product: Perfect Privacy VPN macOS app by Perfect Privacy (CyberDock IT Solutions)

evidence.says: RTINGS reported in its January 23, 2026 update that the provider's site was down and its subscription renewal could not process.
Trekific documents the January 2026 shutdown of the original service and distinguishes it from the differently hosted website that appeared later.
The vendor's GitHub metadata lists a 2023 ARM installer for its later VPN Client without identifying the installer’s bundle ID.

limitation: The final version and architecture of the exact com.perfect-privacy.perfect-privacy-vpn bundle were not verified.
notes: The GitHub ARM package does not establish the architecture of the 2021 scanned macOS app.

name: AJA U-TAP Updater
product: Dolphin Updater helper by the Dolphin Emulator project, conflated with AJA U-TAP Updater

evidence.says: Dolphin’s macOS updater source identifies com.dolphinteam.dolphin-updater as the helper’s former bundle ID.
Dolphin’s macOS build script places Dolphin Updater.app under Dolphin.app/Contents/Helpers.
The separate AJA firmware updater in the official 1.5.7 ZIP has bundle ID com.aja.utapconfig and an x86_64-only main executable in version 1.5.7.22.

notes: Two unrelated updater scans were grouped under the AJA label. The recorded bundle ID belongs to Dolphin. The Intel finding applies to the separately identified AJA updater.

name: Intego Backup Assistant
product: Intego Backup Assistant 2 by Intego for LaCie

evidence.says: Seagate offers the Intego Backup Assistant installer for LaCie customers.
Seagate lists Intego Backup Assistant 2.20 or later as supported on Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 27.
The official DMG package payload contains the matching com.intego.Intego-Backup-Assistant 2.20 build 4328 and its main Intego Backup Assistant executable is universal arm64 and x86_64.

notes: The vendor's download identifies the current public package as 2.20 build 4328, while the historical scan reports 2.80. The version here is from the verified download.

name: Canon IJ Scan Utility
product: Canon IJ Scan Utility by Canon

evidence.says: Canon distributes and dates the Mac MX920 scanner driver 19.3.0a and lists the DMG filename.
The official DMG installer payload includes the matching jp.co.canon.ij.scanutility 1.4.0 and its main Canon IJ Scan Utility executable is a universal x86_64 and arm64 Mach-O.

notes: The verified app is bundled with the MX920-series ScanGear driver 19.3.0a. The date is Canon's publication date for that package. Canon separately distributes IJ Scan Utility2 and IJ Scan Utility Lite.

name: ReturntoDarkCastle
product: Return to Dark Castle (original Mac App Store edition) by Z Sculpt Entertainment and Super Happy Fun Fun

evidence.says: The original publisher identifies Z Sculpt as the developer and names the Mac App Store as the historical distribution channel.
The archived original Apple product page identifies Super Happy Fun Fun and records version 1.4.
Apple's live lookup returns zero results for the original public Mac App Store product.
Ludit's franchise history lists the Super Happy Fun Fun original and its own 2026 release as separate entries.
An existing purchaser reported that a legacy update renamed the app RtDC 2008 and ran on an M1 Mac.

limitation: The architecture, version, and date of the final legacy build could not be verified.
notes: A past purchaser reported receiving a renamed RtDC 2008 update in February 2026 and playing it on M1. Ludit's current re-release has its own App Store record.

name: MathMagic Pro InD
product: MathMagic Pro Edition for Adobe InDesign by InfoLogic

evidence.says: InfoLogic lists MathMagic Pro for InDesign 10.51 for macOS and dates this release November 24, 2026.
The legacy product page lists version 9.41 of MathMagic Pro Edition for Adobe InDesign, the version named in the historical scan.
Inspection of Info.plist and the main MathMagic Pro for InDesign executable within InfoLogic's ZIP confirmed version 10.51 and both arm64 and x86_64 Mach-O slices.

notes: The 64-bit application uses com.InfoLogic.MathMagic-Pro-for-InDesign. This verification covers the standalone editor bundled with the InDesign plug-ins.
